notes.title: Easier to use Lantern ⬆️ up arrow / d-pad up to toggle the lantern on or off
notes.notes: From player feedback, rather than having to equip the lantern in the left hand, it now has its own dedicated slot. Simply press the ⬆️ up arrow / d-pad up to toggle the lantern on or off.

notes.title: Victory Unlocked: Monk Loot Bug Fixed!
notes.notes:
Good news, adventurers! We’ve addressed a critical issue where battling the Monk occasionally resulted in inconsistent loot drops, blocking progress to the Sewer level. With this latest update, the path forward is clear—loot away and conquer new challenges without a hitch!

Ready your gear and dive back in; the Sewer level awaits...

notes.title: Game Update: Save & Load Feature Now Available!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce a highly-requested feature: the Save & Load system is now live! You can now save your progress and load it anytime, allowing you to pick up exactly where you left off. Whether you're taking a break or want to try different strategies, this new system gives you the freedom to explore the game at your own pace.

To game will save anytime you use the fast travel system and will save your loadout, inventory and discovered locations. Just now there is only 1 save slot, although I'm planning to add more in future updates.

Happy gaming, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update Notes for 21/07/24
notes.notes: Thanks for all your feedback, I'm working through it all now after a short mental health break. In this update, I've added Occulsion culling to larger areas and reduced the camera draw distance. This means theres less lag in large areas now. More updates to come, thanks for your patience.
